candidate_policy: Experimental unsplit/stages3 ordinary TF32; FP32 unchanged; no production-default adoption
historical_fp32_correction: Old native H100 FP32 disabled matmul TF32 but kept cuDNN TF32 enabled; this batch disables both. G02 single-factor intervention reproduces both hashes.
flag_gems_scope: PPU FlagGems context enabled with exclude=[]; verified MM/addmm/BMM and public Triangle Attention entries. This is not 100% model-operator replacement.
native_sdpa_coverage_gap: Installed FlagGems only registers _flash_attention_forward. G02 performs 24 native efficient-SDPA calls and 67 math-SDPA calls per prediction; math dispatch may use registered FlagGems primitives.

profile_attribution.scope: one profiled prediction per configuration; diagnostic only; nested entries must not be added
profile_attribution.warning: Candidate GPU event coverage is incomplete (host counts agree; GPU counts differ). Do not use aggregate profiler kernel totals to compute exact savings, executed FLOPs or MFU.

same_activation_shadow.policy: ordinary TF32 teacher; original outputs returned; identical operands for each local replay
same_activation_shadow.limits: PPU local decomposition only; this does not establish cross-device equality or causal RMSD attribution.
